intro.title: The Dark Lands
paragraphs: For a thousand years the Dark Lord ruled this continent. His flesh crafters bred the orcs and goblins as his slaves, and elves and gnomes served as his overseers, some willingly, some bound to his will.

Twenty years ago he vanished. The human alliance that fought him has gone home, leaving fanatics in their strongholds and raiders on the coast. The orcs and goblins are still bound to him, and no one knows what would happen if he returned or someone took his place.

The former slaves are digging out of the rubble and building settlements in the Borderlands and beyond. Warlords raise beastman armies, flesh-crafted monsters roam the wastes, and the ruins of the empire wait below. Only two gods were ever allowed here: the Blood God and the Lady.
Your party sets out from Rubblegate, on the edge of the Borderlands. Find work, find coin, and perhaps find out what became of him.

epilogues.destroy: The seal cracks in Cinderhold's forge fire. No one will command the bound again: not the party, not a warlord, not the Dark Lord himself if he returns. The bound go on keeping orders twenty years old.
epilogues.give: Elder Gorvash takes the seal and swears it will never give an order. The council locks it away, and every warlord in the Dark Lands now knows where it is.
epilogues.keep: The party keeps the seal. Every bound orc and goblin it meets stands aside at a word, and every faction in the Dark Lands starts to wonder what the party will do with them.

notesEpilogue.none: No crafter's notes survive in safe hands.
notesEpilogue.some: In Cinderhold's strongroom lie {n} sets of crafter's notes, and with them the only future the free beastmen have.
